items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: She was married—she admitted to John Haynes

ctx.x: he would have gone to school here, and he went to St. Joseph's University and took music, he told about it.

Well, I don't know anything about his education here, because, you see, I was the baby, and my grandmother never discussed anything with me. And all of this information that I'm giving you now, I got out of an aunt by marriage. My uncle's wife told me. My sister told me just a smidgen. She wouldn't tell me too much. And then my aunt had died here three years ago. We went out on the 4th of July one time, just the two of us. What was her name? Viola Haynes. Uh-huh. She was married—she admitted to John Haynes, and…
of her, too. Did you have a piano in your grandmother's home? No. I wonder. No. Or any other instruments around? No, not that I can remember. Did you ever learn any music? I know you were
